title: Big Theta
definition: Big Theta (Θ) defines the tight bound of an algorithm. It means the algorithm runs in both O(f(N)) and Omega(f(N)). It describes the exact average-case growth rate.
simpleExplanation: Big O is the 'worst case'. Big Theta is the 'exact average case'.

answers.question: **Basic:** Write a function to implement the core logic of Big Theta.
**Intermediate 1:** Optimize Big Theta to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative numbers.
**Intermediate 2:** Solve a standard interview variation of Big Theta (e.g. LeetCode Medium).
**Advanced:** Scale Big Theta for massive datasets or implement it recursively.
**Expert/FAANG:** Solve Big Theta in O(1) space or O(N) time when constraints are extremely tight.
